instantiated_cells.justification: The principal's expense statement must itemize (list name/address and total) payments to any lobbyist only if the total lobbying expenditures/obligations to that lobbyist exceed $200 during the reporting period.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled text defines who is a 'lobbyist' (including a 5-days-per-reporting-period test) but does not set any compensation dollar threshold that triggers lobbyist licensing/registration.

The statute sets a $500 expenditure/obligation threshold for principal registration (s. 13.64(1)) and for verified-statement exemption (s. 13.621(5)), but no dollar expenditure threshold is provided for when an individual must be licensed as a lobbyist.
Lobbying reporting duties in the provided text are imposed on principals (s. 13.68) and agencies (s. 13.695), not on lobbyists via an independent de minimis dollar filing threshold.

No lobbyist-specific filing requirement with a time-percent de minimis threshold appears in the bundled provisions; time thresholds shown relate to who is a lobbyist (5 days) and to excluding certain non-lobbyist employees (10 hours) from principal reporting (s. 13.68(1)).
